name: Khadi Karigar Janashree Bima Yojana
teBrief: ఖాదీ చేతివృత్తులవారి (స్పిన్నర్లు మరియు చేనేత కార్మికులు) కోసం ఎంఓఎంఎస్ఎంఈ రూపొందించిన సమూహ బీమా పథకం. ఈ పథకం బీమా చేసిన సభ్యుడి సాధారణ మరణం, ప్రమాదవశాత్తు మరణం మరియు వైకల్యానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా బీమా రక్షణను అందిస్తుంది.
ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
agency: Pension Group Schemes Department, Life Insurance Corporation Of India (LIC)
brief: A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for khadi artisans (spinners and weavers). The scheme provides insurance cover against normal death, accidental death and disability of the insured member.
briefFull: A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for khadi artisans (spinners and weavers). The scheme provides insurance cover against normal death, accidental death and disability of the insured member.
details:
A group insurance scheme by MoMSME for khadi artisans (spinners and weavers). The scheme provides insurance cover against normal death, accidental death, permanent or partial disability of the insured artisan. Scholarships are provided to the insurer’s children studying in class 9th to 12th.

The artisan must be member of the approved vocation / occupation groups. This scheme was formulated by Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) in association with the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC).
eligibility:
1. The applicant must be a Khadi Artisan (Khadi Karigar).
1. The age of the applicant must be between 18 and 59 years.
1. The applicant must be a member of the approved vocation/occupation groups.
1. The group must have a minimum of 25 members.
documentsRequired:
- Proof of Age
- Proof of Income (Income Certificate)
- Proof of Occupation
- Aadhaar
- Bank Details (Aadhaar Seeded)
- Death Certificate / Certificate of Disability (case specific)

faqs.q: What defines ‘permanent disability’ as per this scheme?
faqs.a: For the purpose of this scheme, "permanent disability" means the loss of two eyes or two limbs.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం ప్రకారం 'శాశ్వత వైకల్యం' ని ఏది నిర్వచిస్తుంది?

faqs.q: What is the maximum financial assistance provided for death due to natural causes?
faqs.a: A financial assistance of ₹20,000 is provided for death occurring from a natural cause.
faqs.qTe: సహజ కారణాల వల్ల మరణించిన వారికి అందించే గరిష్ట ఆర్థిక సహాయం ఎంత?

faqs.q: Are there any benefits for the children of the applicant?
faqs.a: Yes, there is provision for providing scholarship of ₹300 per quarter for children of a Khadi Karigar, studying in 9th to 12th standard, (subject to a maximum of 2 children per family).

faqs.q: I am a 45 year old khadi weaver. I seek to know if I am too old to apply for the scheme?
faqs.a: The upper age limit in this scheme is 59 yea[?] You are therefore eligible to apply.
faqs.qTe: నేను 45 ఏళ్ల ఖాదీ నేతను. ఈ పథకానికి దరఖాస్తు చేయడానికి నాకు చాలా వయస్సు ఉందా అని నేను తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నాను.

faqs.q: Do I need to be from a particular state in order to be eligible for this scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme is equally applicable to citizens across all the states of India.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకానికి అర్హత పొందడానికి నేను ఒక నిర్దిష్ట రాష్ట్రానికి చెందినవాడిని కావాలా?

faqs.q: Is partial disability covered under this scheme?
faqs.a: Yes, partial disability, i.e. loss of one eye or one limb is completely covered in KKJBY.
faqs.qTe: పాక్షిక వైకల్యం ఈ పథకం పరిధిలోకి వస్తుందా?

faqs.q: By what means shall I be receiving the benefits of the scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme is under the LIC so it will be LIC who issues the benefit to the nominee of the deceased person.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం యొక్క ప్రయోజనాలను నేను ఏ విధంగా పొందాలి?

faqs.q: I seek to know the breakup of the premium contribution?
faqs.a:
Artisan - ₹ 12.5, Khadi Institution - ₹ 25, KVIC - ₹ 12.5
Social Security Fund administered by LIC - ₹ 50.
faqs.qTe: నేను ప్రీమియం సహకారం యొక్క విభజనను తెలుసుకోవాలనుకుంటున్నాను?

faqs.a: At the moment, the scheme only supports offline process of application.
